title: On maximal Dynkin friezes
summary: The maximal entries of Dynkin friezes over the positive integers have recently been determined for all finite Dynkin types except $B_n$ and $D_n$. In this note, we explicitly construct large positive integral points on affine cluster varieties of type $B_n$ (resp. $D_n$), giving rise to friezes of types $B_n$ (resp. $D_n$) over the positive integers with largest entries $F_{n+1} F_{n+2} - 1$ (resp. $F_n F_{n+1} - 1$) where $F_k$ is the $k$-th Fibonacci number. We conjecture that these are the maximal possible entries for their respective Dynkin types.
